{
  "reviewer": "agy",
  "lens": "correctness+spec",
  "findings": [
    {
      "severity": "high",
      "file": "scripts/automation/agent_invoke_cli.py",
      "line": 1189,
      "finding": "_write_audit_event computes blocking_findings_count and accesses findings outside the try-except block without checking that findings is an iterable of dicts.",
      "why": "If untrusted envelope stdout produces a malformed payload (e.g. findings is None or contains non-dict items on a schema_violation outcome), f.get() raises an unhandled AttributeError or TypeError that crashes the CLI and prevents document emission, violating the invariant that observability failures must never crash the process.",
      "suggestion": "Guard element access with isinstance(f, dict), default findings safely, and wrap the entire event dictionary construction within the try-except block."
    },
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "file": "scripts/automation/agent_invoke_cli.py",
      "line": 1074,
      "finding": "_record_token_usage evaluates usage truthiness with 'if usage' rather than checking 'if usage is not None'.",
      "why": "An empty dictionary {} is falsy in Python, so a present but empty usage block erroneously degrades to the char-estimate fallback and records estimated prompt tokens instead of defaulting absent keys to 0 as mandated by TD §5.1.",
      "suggestion": "Change 'if usage' to 'if usage is not None' when deciding whether to call _derive_actual_tokens."
    },
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "file": "scripts/automation/agent_invoke_cli.py",
      "line": 1032,
      "finding": "_derive_actual_tokens catches ValueError but does not catch OverflowError when converting token values with int().",
      "why": "If untrusted usage data contains float('inf') or float('-inf'), int() raises OverflowError (which inherits from ArithmeticError, not ValueError), propagating an unhandled exception that crashes CLI execution.",
      "suggestion": "Add OverflowError to the caught exception tuple in _derive_actual_tokens."
    },
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "file": "scripts/automation/agent_invoke_cli.py",
      "line": 1134,
      "finding": "_bounded_audit_number allows non-finite float values such as NaN and Infinity into audit records.",
      "why": "Non-finite floats produce invalid RFC 8259 JSON in the committed audit log or raise serialization exceptions in strict JSON encoders.",
      "suggestion": "Check math.isfinite(value) and return None if the float is NaN or infinite."
    },
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "file": "tests/automation/test_agent_invoke_cli.py",
      "line": 1740,
      "finding": "Three T3.10 preflight failure tests omit the spec-required assertion on audit record outcome_detail.",
      "why": "TD §9.3 T3.10 requires each test to assert that the audit record is written with the matching outcome_detail, but test_T3_10_posture_invalid_never_spawns_token_tracker, test_T3_10_not_authenticated_via_p7_never_spawns_token_tracker, and test_T3_10_cli_unavailable_never_spawns_token_tracker only verify file existence.",
      "suggestion": "Deserialize the audit record in each of the three tests and assert record['outcome_detail'] matches the expected outcome_detail."
    },
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "file": "scripts/automation/agent_invoke_cli.py",
      "line": 1730,
      "finding": "Requirement TD §9.3 T3.9 (emitting 'usage limit reached' to stderr matching bin/hos-cron's grep pattern on terminal_reason: 'usage_limit') is unimplemented.",
      "why": "Without the specified stderr notification on usage_limit, bin/hos-cron cannot detect that the session hit an account or session limit, risking routing livelocks.",
      "suggestion": "Emit the specified pattern to sys.stderr when terminal_reason is usage_limit and implement test T3.9 asserting against bin/hos-cron's regex."
    }
  ],
  "verdict": "request_changes",
  "summary": "The change correctly establishes TD-D24 Amendment B by preventing token_tracker execution on preflight failures while persisting audit records. However, several critical correctness and spec adherence gaps require fixes: _write_audit_event builds the event outside its try block and unhandled TypeErrors/AttributeErrors on malformed findings will crash the CLI; _record_token_usage improperly treats empty usage dictionaries as absent due to falsy checking rather than defaulting counts to 0; _derive_actual_tokens fails to catch OverflowError on infinite floats; _bounded_audit_number allows non-finite floats into the committed audit log; TD §9.3 requirement T3.9 is completely missing from implementation and tests; and three T3.10 tests omit the required audit record outcome_detail assertions."
}
